entities.name: FMA IA 36 Cóndor
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The IA 36 Cóndor was a projected Argentine jet propelled mid-range airliner, designed in the early 1950s by Kurt Tank for the “Fábrica Militar de Aviones”. It was cancelled in 1958, with no prototypes built, but a full size wood mockup.
